products.name: CoCounsel (Casetext)
products.note: Legal research AI; litigation support; Westlaw integration; attorney work product risk

profile_text.body:
Thomson Reuters (Nasdaq/TSX: TRI) is a publicly traded global content and technology company that describes itself as delivering "technology with purpose" for professionals in legal, tax, trade, accounting, risk, and government sectors. Its platform integrates research, analysis, drafting, and compliance tools, with a stated focus on helping professionals make faster decisions and manage complex workflows. The company publishes ongoing research on AI adoption in professional services, including its 2026 Future of Professionals Report and its 2026 AI in Professional Services Report, the latter drawing on perspectives from more than 1,500 professionals.

Thomson Reuters' primary AI product is CoCounsel, which the company describes as built on principles it calls "Fiduciary-Grade AI" and grounded in content from Westlaw and Practical Law. CoCounsel is positioned for legal research, litigation support, drafting, and multi-step workflows, and is integrated with Westlaw. The company also offers ONESOURCE+, an AI-powered platform connecting tax, trade, legal, and risk functions, and an AI-based trade compliance tool for Harmonized System code classification for import and export. A case study on the site cites a firm called Justly Prudent as having increased its litigation capacity by 100% using CoCounsel and Westlaw AI.

The held facts identify CoCounsel as originating with Casetext and note attorney work product risk as a relevant consideration for the product. Thomson Reuters holds SEC registrant status under CIK 0001124074 and was verified in the registry on August 16, 2026. No litigation or MCP server records are held for the company at this time.
